levels.name: Conviction
levels.description: Diluc deals 15% more DMG to opponents whose HP is above 50%.

levels.name: Searing Ember
levels.description: When Diluc takes DMG, his ATK increases by 10% and his ATK SPD increases by 5%. Lasts for 10s. This effect can stack up to 3 times and can only occur once every 1.5s.

levels.name: Fire and Steel
levels.description: Increases the Level of Searing Onslaught by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Flowing Flame
levels.description: Casting Searing Onslaught in rhythm greatly increases damage dealt. 2s after casting Searing Onslaught, casting the next Searing Onslaught in the combo deals 40% additional DMG. This effect lasts for 2s.

levels.name: Phoenix, Harbinger of Dawn
levels.description: Increases the Level of Dawn by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Flaming Sword, Nemesis of the Dark
levels.description: After casting Searing Onslaught, the next 2 Normal Attacks within the next 6s will have their DMG and ATK SPD increased by 30%. Additionally, Searing Onslaught will not interrupt the Normal Attack combo.
